geometry_definition: Only internal geometric vx/vy are scaled; internal yaw, requested/env/scored command and sensor/servo settings are unchanged. The existing support-load estimate uses modified geometric q. Selected commands do not activate the stride cap.
predictions: Smaller shift reduces velocity ripple unless support contact loss creates instability.
Translation gain makes negative command-direction velocity bias smaller; pure-yaw gain pairs must be identical.
The 2x2 comparison separates main effects and their interaction; no candidate is a qualified policy.
